name: Fluid Motion
description: Smooth, fluid animations for the whole window: softer easing curves, tabs and activity bar icons that glide to their new place, views and editors that cross-fade, menus, pickers, hovers, suggestions and the find widget that ease in, a smooth caret, and ghost text that fades in. Three intensities (Subtle, Fluid, Expressive). Follows "Toggle Animations" and the system's Reduce motion: with either on, nothing moves.
author: AICode

intensity.description: subtle: quick fades only. fluid: smooth eased motion everywhere (default). expressive: longer, springier motion, hover lift and a press ripple on buttons.

flipTabs.description: Tabs glide to their new place when they are reordered, opened or closed.

flipActivityBar.description: Activity bar icons glide when views are added, moved or removed.
